thesis: The bear narrowly carries the immediate-entry objection: the bull ultimately conditions purchase on events not yet observed. Strong latest demand prevents treating the selloff as proof of a broken operating franchise, so the ruling is neutral rather than a fundamental sell.
strongest_counterexample: Official quarterly revenue grew 103% and management guided another increase; this is direct evidence that customers have not abandoned the franchise despite the governance shock.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy if governance findings resolve the principal uncertainty and the next reported quarter delivers revenue within guidance without an additional guided gross-margin reduction.
Reconsider toward sell if the next reported revenue falls below the guided range and management attributes the shortfall to lost customer demand.
evidence_gaps: Cause and durability of the guided gross-margin decline.
Governance outcome and any lasting customer or regulatory effects.
Authenticated same-basis valuation and confirmed price repair.
decisive_factors: Latest observed operating strength conflicts with a confirmed technical decline.
The guided 74.8% to 71–72% gross-margin step-down is unresolved.
The bullish round-two confirmation requirements are explicitly unmet.
